summary: Bilibili Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an attached monthly return submitted to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, detailing movements in authorized and issued share capital for May 2026. The report shows no changes in authorized shares, a slight increase of 162,956 Class Z ordinary shares issued (from 336,928,637 to 337,091,593), and no treasury share activity. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing akin to a US Form 8-K for share capital updates. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions or tender offers. The filing confirms public float sufficiency. Watch for no further event; this is administrative.
